text:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty escalation - P12345: elevated 5xx rate (>8%) across /v1/generate hosted API in us-west-2. Error patterns: Envoy 502/503, gateway timeouts. Auto-set priority: P0. Please ack and join.

alice: Ack - oncall here. Seeing spike on dashboards. Raising channel. Any immediate mitigation suggestions?

ben: I'm checking envoy metrics now. promql: sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_total{envoy_cluster_name=~'prod.*'}[1m])) by (envoy_cluster_name)

carol: Also seeing increased retries and upstream_reset due to route failures. Could be a bad route config or a new canary rollout.

dylan: I rolled a small change to envoy config earlier (~20m ago) for retry/backoff tuning. Reverting is safest if it's correlated.

alice: Can someone confirm which instances got the config? kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=envoy -o wide

ben: Output from one host: envoy-5f8d9 pod on ip 10.2.4.12 running latest config v2026-03-14T12:10. Patch time matches dylan's deploy.

dylan: Confirmed I pushed a route change to prefer new upstream pool 'infer-v2-canary' and increased per-try timeout. I also enabled circuit_breakers for that cluster with max_connections=100, max_pending_requests=50.

eve: I'm seeing logs with 502 response and upstream reset: connection failure plus: upstream-v2-canary timeout. Stack traces show Envoy mapping upstream 504 to 502 for the client.

alice: Customer impact: spike in 5xx across multiple customers using hosted API. Some high-volume tenants report timeouts. Setting status page draft.

ben: Quick mitigation idea: remove canary from route, fallback to stable 'infer-v1' pool, and reduce retries to 1. I can push a temp config via envoy admin API or patch k8s configmap and trigger rolling restart.

carol: We have a live route config in k8s: cm envoy-route-prod. I'll prepare a patch to revert 'infer-v2-canary' weight to 0.

alice: While carol prepares that, can we also disable automatic retries in the LB to avoid retry storms? Set retry_on to 'none' or remove retriable_status_codes.

dylan: I'll open a temporary admin endpoint change on the canary nodes: curl -X POST http://10.2.4.12:9901/runtime_modify and then restart envoy if needed.

ben: Also running a Prometheus query to confirm error distribution: sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx{envoy_cluster_name=~'infer.*'}[1m])) by (envoy_cluster_name)

eve: Logs snippet from envoy-5f8d9:
```
[2026-03-14T12:23:40Z] envoy upstream reset: reason=connection failure, details=resource_exhausted
[2026-03-14T12:23:41Z] route | cluster infer-v2-canary | 502 | upstream_timeout
```

carol: Patch ready. kubectl -n infra patch configmap/envoy-route-prod --patch 'data: {routes.json: "...REVERTED..."}'

alice: Apply patch, then trigger rolling restart of envoy pods in the deployment with: kubectl rollout restart deployment/envoy-prod -n infra

carol: Patch applied. Rolling restart started. Watching pods.

ben: Metrics responding — 5xx rate dropping from 8.5% to 1.2% in the last 2 minutes. Still watching.

dylan: After rollback, the canary-specific circuit_breaker config is gone. I will follow up with a PR to add safer CB thresholds and health checks before reintroducing.

eve: Customer-facing note: short-lived elevated errors from 12:18–12:28 UTC, primarily in us-west-2. Affected requests returned 5xx. Recommend notifying support to prepare for outreach.

alice: Handoff: I'm staying on until 13:00 UTC then handing to ben for next hour. ben, please continue monitoring and coordinate postmortem.

ben: Ack. I'll collect traces, config diffs, and a timeline. I'll also check whether retry behavior amplified the failures.

alice: Status page update posted (draft) — will publish when we confirm stabilization. Thanks everyone. :tada: 

incidents-bot: Incident P12345 acknowledged by alice. Severity P0 -> follow up with postmortem tag and assign lead: ben.

ben: Assigning postmortem owner and creating doc: /docs/incidents/P12345-envoy-canary-routing.json. Will ping for details.

carol: FYI: Adding an alert to catch large config rollouts: add 'config_rollout_rate' anomaly detection for envoy configmap changes.

dylan: Will open PR with improved health checks and circuit breaker defaults. We'll also add canary traffic caps to avoid impact to global pool.

alice: Closing channel for now, but keep on-call loop if metrics change. Thanks all. :wave:
